title: Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. Completes Strategic Merger with Advanced Integration Technologies
主要内容: Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. (UCTT) completed its merger with Advanced Integration Technologies (AIT) on July 9, 2012. The merger adds new customers in the semiconductor capital equipment and medical equipment markets, and enhances UCTT's manufacturing capabilities in complete tools, frame manufacturing, and sheet metal fabrication. AIT's 2011 revenue was nearly $170M, significantly increasing UCTT's scale. The merger is expected to be accretive to earnings for 2012 and 2013. It also leverages combined Asian manufacturing capabilities and supports global expansion through UCTT's vertical integration model.
